title: Your First Weekend at Farmingdale State College, Shared as Cards
description: A Friday-to-Sunday introduction to campus gathering spaces, art, horticulture, aviation history, outdoor recreation, and downtown Farmingdale.

cards.title: Start Friday with Campus Art
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Hale Hall
cards.notes: Call ahead, then begin in Hale Hall with the current Memorial Gallery exhibition before its weekday visiting period ends.
cards.short_summary: Use a compact campus exhibition as the weekend’s opening stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale State College identifies Memorial Gallery as a free, mobility-accessible exhibition space in Hale Hall and asks visitors to call ahead.
cards.access_notes: The department lists Monday–Friday hours of 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; call ahead before visiting.

cards.title: Learn the Library Layout
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Greenley Hall
cards.notes: Walk through the library before Friday closing and locate circulation, reference help, archives, and the spaces you may need later.
cards.short_summary: Turn the first library visit into practical campus orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official page lists circulation, reference, College Archives, government documents, accessibility information, and current hours.
cards.access_notes: Summer 2026 hours are Friday 7:45 a.m.–5 p.m., with Saturday and Sunday closed; academic-year hours differ.

cards.title: Get Oriented over Dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · campus dining hub
cards.notes: Compare the posted dining choices and current service hours, then use the student lounge to sketch out the rest of the weekend.
cards.short_summary: Pair a meal decision with an introduction to the campus hub.
cards.evidence_claim: FSC lists the Campus Center Food Court among its dining choices, while the campus map identifies Campus Center as a named destination.
cards.access_notes: Check the linked campus-dining provider for current venue hours and availability before going.

cards.title: Find the Student-Activities Base
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Quintyne Hall
cards.notes: Locate the student-activities office and common areas now, then review the organization list for a group to contact next week.
cards.short_summary: Map where campus involvement begins before choosing a club.
cards.evidence_claim: FSC places the Office of Student Activities in Quintyne Hall 111 and publishes a current list of recognized student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Office hours are Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; building access outside those hours is not stated.

cards.title: Spend Saturday with Historic Aircraft
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Republic Airport
cards.notes: Arrive before the final-admission cutoff and focus your visit on the museum’s documented aircraft and aviation-history displays.
cards.short_summary: Connect Farmingdale’s aviation setting to preserved aircraft history.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official visitor page lists its Farmingdale address, Wednesday–Sunday operating hours, admission prices, and final-admission policy.
cards.source_title: General Admission & Hours - American Airpower Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday 10 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; last admission is 30 minutes before closing. Special-event schedules may vary.

cards.title: Choose an Afternoon Trail
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Bethpage State Park
cards.notes: Check the official trail map and conditions, then choose a hike or bike route suited to your group and available daylight.
cards.short_summary: Follow the aviation stop with self-directed outdoor recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: New York State Parks documents hiking and biking trails, picnic facilities, playing fields, tennis courts, and bridle paths at Bethpage State Park.
cards.source_title: Bethpage State Park - New York State Parks & Historic Sites
cards.access_notes: Review the official park page and trail map for current conditions, permitted uses, parking, and any applicable fees.

cards.title: Walk Downtown after the Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the two-block event area as a clear walking segment, checking current merchant pages before choosing any optional food or shopping.
cards.short_summary: See the village center through a defined, walkable downtown segment.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Music on Main site identifies a two-block downtown section of Main Street between Prospect Street and South Front Street.
cards.access_notes: Main Street is a public downtown corridor; event-related closures and programming occur only on announced dates.

cards.entity_name: Farmingdale Farmers Market at Village Green
cards.title: Browse the Sunday Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · Village Green
cards.notes: Visit during the published Sunday window, browse the stalls without assuming purchases, and confirm weather updates before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Begin Sunday at a recurring community gathering on the green.
cards.evidence_claim: The Farmingdale Business Improvement District lists the 2026 Farmers Market at Village Green on Sundays from June 7 through November 22, 10 a.m.–2 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled Sundays, June 7–November 22, 2026, from 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; verify weather or event changes before traveling.

cards.title: Study the Teaching Gardens
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Farmingdale State College
cards.notes: Return to campus for a daylight walk, enter through the marked garden entrance, and examine the horticultural landscape respectfully.
cards.short_summary: Use a named campus landscape to reconnect with FSC’s horticultural history.
cards.evidence_claim: FSC documents the naming of the Ornamental Horticulture Teaching Gardens for alumnus Robert F. Ench and a plaque at the main entrance.
cards.source_title: Teaching Gardens Dedicated to Horticulturist Robert F. Ench ’60
cards.access_notes: The source does not publish visitor hours; visit only when the garden is visibly open and follow posted campus rules.

cards.title: Finish on the Great Lawn
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: End with a daylight walk across the mapped lawn and use the surrounding building views to rehearse your weekday campus route.
cards.short_summary: Close the weekend by turning the campus core into a mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: Farmingdale State College’s official interactive campus map identifies Great Lawn as a named campus location.
cards.source_title: Farmingdale State College AnyMap Interactive Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access hours are not published on the map; remain on open paths and observe posted campus restrictions.
